messages:
incident-bot: PAGE triggered — runtime.decode p99 spike (us-west-2). SLO breach detected for service=runtime.decode, metric=p99_latency. Auto-sev assigned: sev2.

maria (oncall): ACK — I’m on it. Paging #oncall. Noted increase starting ~1738523200. Routing impact looks concentrated on streaming endpoints.

sam (eng-runtime): digging in — can see p95 from ~300ms -> ~1.1s, p99 from ~900ms -> ~3.4s in the last 30m. Streaming stall rate +12%. Top tail hosts are on kernel build: kernel-trt8-2026-03-12 (deployed ~2h ago). Canary passed small traffic but rollout hit prod at 10:12.

lee (sre): any evictions/pagefault spam in dmesg? paste the live tail link.

maria (oncall): graph: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/rt-decode/p99_tail?from=1738523000&to=1738524100

sam (eng-runtime): logs excerpt from a prod node (sanitized):
```
[warn] kv_cache: eviction triggered, in_use=0.92, max=0.9
[error] compilepath: kernel module load failed: symbol mismatch (trt_flash_attn_v2)
[info] runtime.decode: falling back to slow path
[warn] pagefaults: minor: 2300, major: 3
```

ajay (eng-ml): the trt8+flashattn-v2 kernels pull in a new compile pipeline. We flipped `-funsafe-math-optimizations` and `-O3 -march=native` in that build for perf. If the kernel modulized ops change codegen we can get path-length regressions in decode.

sam (eng-runtime): confirmed — the CI job that produced kernel-trt8-2026-03-12 set `CFLAGS+=-ffast-math -funroll-loops`. We also enabled the new aten kernel variant. Repro on a staging node by toggling those flags reproduces p99 tail.

lee (sre): customer impact? product, any escalations?

erin (product): support volume up 3 tickets mentioning slow streaming and timeouts for chat completions. Top customer: Acme Payments (3 impacted sessions, SLA alert). Not widespread yet but visible for heavy streaming workloads (30s+ sessions).

maria (oncall): mitigation options: 1) reroute traffic away from kernel-trt8 cluster to kernel-stable 2) hotpatch nodes to unload new module 3) rollback control-plane rollout for that kernel tag. Which is fastest?

sam (eng-runtime): quickest is routing control-plane change. We can flip route policy to prefer kernel:stable for model:decode. Command:
```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/reroute -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"selector":"model=decode","prefer":"kernel:stable","reason":"paging tail regression 1738524100"}'
```
This should hit within 30s for new requests; existing reservations may take longer.

lee (sre): I'll prepare a node-level hotpatch play if reroute insufficient. Also adding evict-kernel module as a fallback: `systemctl stop kernel-module-trt8 && modprobe -r trt_flash_attn_v2` (requires draining tasks).

ajay (eng-ml): if we route to stable we may lose some token-throughput perf but reduce p99 massively. Also consider toggling the compiler flag gate in our kernel builds to disable `-ffast-math` on the next quick rebuild.

erin (product): prioritize routing + customer notifications. I’ll draft a short message for Acme and affected customers: close to P95 regressions but we can offer mitigation steps.

maria (oncall): applying reroute now. Will post status.

cicd-bot: controlplane change accepted — reroute job 8921 queued.

maria (oncall): reroute job completed. Observability link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/rt-decode/rollouts?from=1738524100&to=1738524450

sam (eng-runtime): preliminary numbers: p95 down to ~420ms, p99 down to ~1.0s after reroute for the majority of traffic. Streaming stalls decreasing. Some nodes still show tail due to long-running sessions pinned to older reservations.

lee (sre): starting node hotpatch on 3 highest-traffic hosts (drain->stop module->restart). Will coordinate in #eng-sre for rolling operations.

maria (oncall): handoff note for night team: severity currently sev2, reroute applied, hotpatch in progress. Handoff to @lee for overnight monitoring.

lee (sre): copying follow-ups: 1) collect `dmesg` and `modinfo` output from affected nodes, 2) gather staging repro steps, 3) rollback plan if hotpatch fails.

sam (eng-runtime): follow-ups for eng-runtime/eng-ml: pinning work-item — rebuild kernel-trt8 without `-ffast-math` and without `-funroll-loops`, run perf + tail SLO tests on staging. Tag: kernel-trt8-2026-03-12-fixed.

ajay (eng-ml): I'll own the rebuild. ETA 3h for quick build + canary.

erin (product): customer comms queued. Notifying Acme now (they requested proactive notice).

incident-bot: Severity updated to sev2 -> mitigation in progress. Next update scheduled in 30m or on status change.

maria (oncall): last check before handoff — p99 stabilized near baseline for new requests. Leaving notes and links in the incident runbook. If hotpatch reveals module unload errors, escalate to kernel-build-owner @sam.

lee (sre): acknowledged handoff. I’ll monitor p95/p99, streaming stall %, and ticket queue overnight. Leaving a short checklist in the thread.

maria (oncall): closing active pager on my side — handing to lee at 1738524450. Thanks all.
